import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Filter Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedJointDensityBayesGeneral25
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ] (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν]
variable (p : X × Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : Measurable p)
include hp

def marginalDensity (y : Y) : ℝ≥0∞ := ∫⁻ x, p (x,y) ∂μ

theorem marginalDensity_measurable : Measurable (marginalDensity μ p) :=
  hp.lintegral_prod_left'

def regularEvidence : Set Y := {y | marginalDensity μ p y ≠ 0 ∧ marginalDensity μ p y ≠ ∞}

theorem regularEvidence_measurable : MeasurableSet (regularEvidence μ p) := by
  exact (measurableSet_eq_fun (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp) measurable_const).compl.inter
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp) measurable_const).compl

def safeNormalizer (y : Y) : ℝ≥0∞ := by
  classical
  exact if y ∈ regularEvidence μ p then marginalDensity μ p y else 1

theorem safeNormalizer_measurable : Measurable (safeNormalizer μ p) := by
  exact (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp).piecewise
    (regularEvidence_measurable μ p hp) measurable_const

theorem safeNormalizer_ne_zero (y : Y) : safeNormalizer μ p y ≠ 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases hy : y ∈ regularEvidence μ p
  · simpa [safeNormalizer,hy] using hy.1
  · simp [safeNormalizer,hy]

def normalizedDensity (y : Y) (x : X) : ℝ≥0∞ := by
  classical
  exact if y ∈ regularEvidence μ p then p (x,y) / safeNormalizer μ p y else 0

theorem normalizedDensity_measurable : Measurable (Function.uncurry (normalizedDensity μ p)) := by
  classical
  change Measurable (fun yx : Y × X => if yx.1 ∈ regularEvidence μ p
    then p (yx.2,yx.1) / safeNormalizer μ p yx.1 else 0)
  exact ((hp.comp measurable_swap).div
    ((safeNormalizer_measurable μ p hp).comp measurable_fst)).piecewise
      ((regularEvidence_measurable μ p hp).preimage measurable_fst) measurable_const

def posteriorKernel (x0 : X) : Kernel Y X := by
  classical
  exact Kernel.piecewise (regularEvidence_measurable μ p hp)
    ((Kernel.const Y μ).withDensity (normalizedDensity μ p))
    (Kernel.const Y (Measure.dirac x0))

theorem actual_positive_finite_evidence_posterior_has_the_ratio_density
    (x0 : X) (y : Y) (hy : y ∈ regularEvidence μ p) :
    posteriorKernel μ p hp x0 y = μ.withDensity (fun x => p (x,y) / marginalDensity μ p y) := by
  classical
  simp only [posteriorKernel,Kernel.piecewise_apply,ite_eq_left hy]
  rw [Kernel.withDensity_apply _ (normalizedDensity_measurable μ p hp),Kernel.const_apply]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp [normalizedDensity,safeNormalizer,hy]

instance posteriorKernel_markov (x0 : X) : IsMarkovKernel (posteriorKernel μ p hp x0) := by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun y => ⟨?_⟩⟩
  by_cases hy : y ∈ regularEvidence μ p
  · rw [actual_positive_finite_evidence_posterior_has_the_ratio_density μ p hp x0 y hy,
      withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,Measure.restrict_univ]
    simp_rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    have hsection : Measurable (fun x => p (x,y)) := hp.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
    rw [lintegral_mul_const _ hsection]
    exact ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hy.1 hy.2
  · simp [posteriorKernel,Kernel.piecewise_apply,hy]

theorem actual_joint_density_y_marginal_is_its_integrated_density :
    ((μ.prod ν).withDensity p).map Prod.snd = ν.withDensity (marginalDensity μ p) := by
  apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
  intro test htest
  rw [lintegral_map htest measurable_snd]
  change (∫⁻ xy, (test ∘ Prod.snd) xy ∂(μ.prod ν).withDensity p) = _
  rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hp (htest.comp measurable_snd),
    lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp) htest]
  rw [lintegral_prod_symm _ ((hp.mul (htest.comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro y
  change (∫⁻ x, p (x,y) * test y ∂μ) = marginalDensity μ p y * test y
  exact lintegral_mul_const _ (show Measurable (fun x => p (x,y)) from hp.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const))

theorem actual_probability_joint_has_normalized_marginal
    (hnorm : ∫⁻ xy, p xy ∂μ.prod ν = 1) :
    ∫⁻ y, marginalDensity μ p y ∂ν = 1 := by
  change (∫⁻ y, ∫⁻ x, p (x,y) ∂μ ∂ν) = 1
  rw [← lintegral_prod_symm _ hp.aemeasurable]
  exact hnorm

theorem actual_probability_joint_has_almost_everywhere_regular_evidence
    (hnorm : ∫⁻ xy, p xy ∂μ.prod ν = 1) :
    ∀ᵐ y ∂ν.withDensity (marginalDensity μ p), y ∈ regularEvidence μ p := by
  have hfinite : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, marginalDensity μ p y ≠ ∞ := by
    have := ae_lt_top (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp)
      (show (∫⁻ y, marginalDensity μ p y ∂ν) ≠ ∞ by
        rw [actual_probability_joint_has_normalized_marginal μ ν p hp hnorm]; simp)
    filter_upwards [this] with y hy
    exact hy.ne
  rw [ae_withDensity_iff (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp)]
  filter_upwards [hfinite] with y hy hpos
  exact ⟨hpos,hy⟩

theorem actual_probability_joint_reversed_is_its_marginal_and_ratio_posterior
    (x0 : X)
    (hnorm : ∫⁻ xy, p xy ∂μ.prod ν = 1) :
    ((μ.prod ν).withDensity p).map Prod.swap =
      ν.withDensity (marginalDensity μ p) ⊗ₘ posteriorKernel μ p hp x0 := by
  let densityKernel := (Kernel.const Y μ).withDensity (normalizedDensity μ p)
  haveI hdensityFinite : IsFiniteKernel densityKernel := by
    refine ⟨1,by simp,fun y => ?_⟩
    rw [show densityKernel y = μ.withDensity (normalizedDensity μ p y) by
      exact Kernel.withDensity_apply _ (normalizedDensity_measurable μ p hp) y,
      withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,Measure.restrict_univ]
    by_cases hy : y ∈ regularEvidence μ p
    · simp only [normalizedDensity,hy,ite_true,safeNormalizer]
      simp only [hy,ite_true,div_eq_mul_inv]
      have hs : Measurable (fun x => p (x,y)) := hp.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)
      rw [lintegral_mul_const _ hs]
      exact le_of_eq (ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hy.1 hy.2)
    · simp [normalizedDensity,hy]
  have heq : posteriorKernel μ p hp x0 =ᵐ[ν.withDensity (marginalDensity μ p)] densityKernel := by
    filter_upwards [actual_probability_joint_has_almost_everywhere_regular_evidence μ ν p hp hnorm]
      with y hy
    simp [posteriorKernel,Kernel.piecewise_apply,hy,densityKernel]
  rw [Measure.compProd_congr heq]
  rw [Measure.withDensity_compProd_withDensity (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp)
    (normalizedDensity_measurable μ p hp),Measure.compProd_const]
  have hswap : ((μ.prod ν).withDensity p).map Prod.swap =
      (ν.prod μ).withDensity (fun yx => p (yx.2,yx.1)) := by
    apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
    intro test htest
    rw [lintegral_map htest measurable_swap]
    change (∫⁻ xy, (test ∘ Prod.swap) xy ∂(μ.prod ν).withDensity p) = _
    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hp (htest.comp measurable_swap)]
    change _ = (∫⁻ yx, test yx ∂(ν.prod μ).withDensity (p ∘ Prod.swap))
    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (hp.comp measurable_swap) htest]
    have ht : Measurable (fun yx : Y × X => p yx.swap * test yx) :=
      (hp.comp measurable_swap).mul htest
    have h := lintegral_map ht measurable_swap (μ := μ.prod ν)
    rw [Measure.prod_swap] at h
    simpa only [Prod.swap_swap,Function.comp_def,Pi.mul_apply] using h.symm
  rw [hswap]
  apply withDensity_congr_ae
  have hfiniteMarginal : ∀ᵐ y ∂ν, marginalDensity μ p y ≠ ∞ := by
    have h := ae_lt_top (marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp)
      (show (∫⁻ y, marginalDensity μ p y ∂ν) ≠ ∞ by
        rw [actual_probability_joint_has_normalized_marginal μ ν p hp hnorm]; simp)
    filter_upwards [h] with y hy
    exact hy.ne
  change ∀ᵐ yx ∂ν.prod μ, p (yx.2,yx.1) = marginalDensity μ p yx.1 * normalizedDensity μ p yx.1 yx.2
  apply (Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae (μ := ν) (ν := μ)
    (measurableSet_eq_fun (hp.comp measurable_swap)
      (((marginalDensity_measurable μ p hp).comp measurable_fst).mul
        (normalizedDensity_measurable μ p hp)))).mpr
  filter_upwards [hfiniteMarginal] with y hy
  by_cases hzero : marginalDensity μ p y = 0
  · have hz : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, p (x,y) = 0 :=
      (lintegral_eq_zero_iff (hp.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const))).mp hzero
    filter_upwards [hz] with x hx
    simp [hzero,hx]
  · filter_upwards with x
    have hreg : y ∈ regularEvidence μ p := ⟨hzero,hy⟩
    change p (x,y) = marginalDensity μ p y * normalizedDensity μ p y x
    simp only [normalizedDensity,hreg,ite_true]
    rw [show safeNormalizer μ p y = marginalDensity μ p y by simp [safeNormalizer,hreg]]
    exact (ENNReal.mul_div_cancel hzero hy).symm

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedJointDensityBayesGeneral25

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal
namespace SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedPriorLikelihoodDensity25
variable {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
variable (μ : Measure X) [SFinite μ] (ν : Measure Y) [SFinite ν]
variable (prior : X → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : Measurable prior)
variable (likelihood : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hl : Measurable (Function.uncurry likelihood))
include hp hl

def likelihoodKernel : Kernel X Y := (Kernel.const X ν).withDensity likelihood

theorem actual_normalized_likelihood_is_markov
    (hlone : ∀ x, ∫⁻ y, likelihood x y ∂ν = 1) :
    IsMarkovKernel (likelihoodKernel ν likelihood) := by
  refine ⟨fun x => ⟨?_⟩⟩
  rw [likelihoodKernel,Kernel.withDensity_apply _ hl,Kernel.const_apply,
    withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,Measure.restrict_univ]
  exact hlone x

theorem actual_normalized_prior_is_probability
    (hpone : ∫⁻ x, prior x ∂μ = 1) : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ.withDensity prior) := by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [withDensity_apply _ MeasurableSet.univ,Measure.restrict_univ]
  exact hpone

theorem actual_generated_joint_has_prior_times_likelihood_density
    (hlone : ∀ x, ∫⁻ y, likelihood x y ∂ν = 1) :
    μ.withDensity prior ⊗ₘ likelihoodKernel ν likelihood =
      (μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun xy => prior xy.1 * likelihood xy.1 xy.2) := by
  haveI hm : IsMarkovKernel ((Kernel.const X ν).withDensity likelihood) :=
    actual_normalized_likelihood_is_markov (ν := ν) (prior := prior) (hp := hp) (likelihood := likelihood) (hl := hl) hlone
  rw [likelihoodKernel,Measure.withDensity_compProd_withDensity (κ := Kernel.const X ν) hp hl,
    Measure.compProd_const]

theorem actual_prior_times_likelihood_joint_is_normalized
    (hpone : ∫⁻ x, prior x ∂μ = 1)
    (hlone : ∀ x, ∫⁻ y, likelihood x y ∂ν = 1) :
    ∫⁻ xy, prior xy.1 * likelihood xy.1 xy.2 ∂μ.prod ν = 1 := by
  have hpj : Measurable (fun xy : X × Y => prior xy.1 * likelihood xy.1 xy.2) :=
    (hp.comp measurable_fst).mul hl
  rw [lintegral_prod _ hpj.aemeasurable]
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, prior x * likelihood x y ∂ν ∂μ) = ∫⁻ x, prior x * 1 ∂μ := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro x
      have hs : Measurable (fun y => likelihood x y) := hl.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
      rw [lintegral_const_mul _ hs,hlone x]
    _ = 1 := by simpa using hpone

theorem actual_generated_data_law_has_integrated_likelihood_density
    (hlone : ∀ x, ∫⁻ y, likelihood x y ∂ν = 1) :
    (μ.withDensity prior ⊗ₘ likelihoodKernel ν likelihood).map Prod.snd =
      ν.withDensity (fun y => ∫⁻ x, likelihood x y * prior x ∂μ) := by
  rw [actual_generated_joint_has_prior_times_likelihood_density μ ν prior hp likelihood hl hlone]
  apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
  intro test htest
  rw [lintegral_map htest measurable_snd]
  change (∫⁻ xy, (test ∘ Prod.snd) xy ∂(μ.prod ν).withDensity (fun xy => prior xy.1 * likelihood xy.1 xy.2)) = _
  have hpj : Measurable (fun xy : X × Y => prior xy.1 * likelihood xy.1 xy.2) :=
    (hp.comp measurable_fst).mul hl
  have hdata : Measurable (fun y => ∫⁻ x, likelihood x y * prior x ∂μ) :=
    (hl.mul (hp.comp measurable_fst)).lintegral_prod_left'
  rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hpj (htest.comp measurable_snd),
    lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ hdata htest,
    lintegral_prod_symm _ (hpj.mul (htest.comp measurable_snd)).aemeasurable]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro y
  have hs : Measurable (fun x => likelihood x y * prior x) :=
    (hl.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).mul hp
  change (∫⁻ x, (prior x * likelihood x y) * test y ∂μ) = (∫⁻ x, likelihood x y * prior x ∂μ) * test y
  rw [← lintegral_mul_const _ hs]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro x
  rw [mul_comm (prior x) (likelihood x y)]

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedPriorLikelihoodDensity25

import Mathlib
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Set
open scoped ENNReal NNReal BigOperators Function

variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]

theorem actual_conditioning_restricts_rescales_and_retains_the_event
    (B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hp : 0 < μ.real B) :
    μ[|B] = (μ B)⁻¹ • μ.restrict B ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure μ[|B] ∧
      (∀ᵐ ω ∂μ[|B], ω ∈ B) := by
  have hn : μ B ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have : μ.real B = 0 := by simp [measureReal_def, hz]
    linarith
  exact ⟨rfl, cond_isProbabilityMeasure hn, ae_cond_mem hB⟩

omit [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] in
theorem actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio
    (A B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (μ[|B]).real A = μ.real (A ∩ B) / μ.real B := by
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal (cond_apply hB μ A)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ← measureReal_def,
    Set.inter_comm B A, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h

theorem actual_conditional_probability_product_rule
    (A B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
    (μ[|B]).real A * μ.real B = μ.real (A ∩ B) := by
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal (cond_mul_eq_inter hB A μ)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ← measureReal_def, Set.inter_comm B A] using h

theorem actual_finite_partition_total_probability
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : ι → Set Ω)
    (hB : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on B))
    (hc : (⋃ i, B i) = univ) (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    μ.real A = ∑ i, (μ[|B i]).real A * μ.real (B i) := by
  have hh := measureReal_iUnion_fintype (μ:=μ)
    (f:=fun i => A ∩ B i)
    (fun i j hij => (hd hij).mono inter_subset_right inter_subset_right)
    (fun i => hA.inter (hB i))
  rw [← inter_iUnion, hc, inter_univ] at hh
  rw [hh]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ =>
    (actual_conditional_probability_product_rule μ A (B i) (hB i)).symm)

theorem actual_finite_partition_Bayes_rule
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : ι → Set Ω)
    (hB : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (B i)) (hd : Pairwise (Disjoint on B))
    (hc : (⋃ i, B i) = univ) (A : Set Ω) (hA : MeasurableSet A) (i : ι) :
    (μ[|A]).real (B i) = ((μ[|B i]).real A * μ.real (B i)) /
      (∑ j, (μ[|B j]).real A * μ.real (B j)) := by
  rw [actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio μ (B i) A hA,
    inter_comm, ← actual_conditional_probability_product_rule μ A (B i) (hB i),
    ← actual_finite_partition_total_probability μ B hB hd hc A hA]

/-- Fault/alarm, fault/quiet, healthy/alarm, healthy/quiet. -/
def alarmWeights : Fin 4 → ℝ≥0 := ![19/2000, 1/2000, 99/2000, 1881/2000]
def alarmPMF : PMF (Fin 4) := PMF.ofFintype
  (fun i => (alarmWeights i : ℝ≥0∞))
  (by norm_cast; norm_num [alarmWeights, Fin.sum_univ_succ])
def alarmLaw : Measure (Fin 4) := alarmPMF.toMeasure
instance alarmProbability : IsProbabilityMeasure alarmLaw := by
  unfold alarmLaw
  infer_instance

def faulty : Set (Fin 4) := {i | i = 0 ∨ i = 1}
def alarm : Set (Fin 4) := {i | i = 0 ∨ i = 2}

private theorem actual_alarm_events :
    alarmLaw.real faulty = 1/100 ∧ alarmLaw.real alarm = 59/1000 ∧
      alarmLaw.real (faulty ∩ alarm) = 19/2000 ∧
      alarmLaw.real (faultyᶜ ∩ alarm) = 99/2000 ∧
      alarmLaw.real faultyᶜ = 99/100 := by
  norm_num [alarmLaw, alarmPMF, alarmWeights, faulty, alarm, measureReal_def,
    PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Set.indicator,
    ← ENNReal.coe_add, ENNReal.toReal_add]
  all_goals simp (disch := finiteness) only [ENNReal.toReal_add]
  all_goals norm_num

theorem actual_normalized_alarm_experiment_has_the_source_prior_and_rates :
    alarmLaw.real faulty = 1/100 ∧
    (alarmLaw[|faulty]).real alarm = 95/100 ∧
    (alarmLaw[|faultyᶜ]).real alarm = 5/100 := by
  have h := actual_alarm_events
  rw [actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio alarmLaw alarm faulty
    (Set.toFinite faulty).measurableSet,
    actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio alarmLaw alarm faultyᶜ
    (Set.toFinite faultyᶜ).measurableSet,
    inter_comm alarm faulty, inter_comm alarm faultyᶜ]
  norm_num [h.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.2]

theorem actual_alarm_posterior_and_complement_are_true_conditionals :
    (alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faulty = 19/118 ∧
    (alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faultyᶜ = 99/118 := by
  have h := actual_alarm_events
  rw [actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio alarmLaw faulty alarm
    (Set.toFinite alarm).measurableSet,
    actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio alarmLaw faultyᶜ alarm
    (Set.toFinite alarm).measurableSet]
  norm_num [h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2.1]

theorem actual_alarm_posterior_printed_fraction_rounding_and_five_of_six :
    (alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faulty = (95/100:ℝ)*(1/100) /
      ((95/100)*(1/100)+(5/100)*(99/100)) ∧
    |(alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faulty - (161/1000:ℝ)| < 1/2000 ∧
    |(alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faultyᶜ - (5/6:ℝ)| < 1/100 ∧
    (alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faulty ≠ (alarmLaw[|faultyᶜ]).real alarm := by
  rw [actual_alarm_posterior_and_complement_are_true_conditionals.1,
    actual_alarm_posterior_and_complement_are_true_conditionals.2,
    actual_normalized_alarm_experiment_has_the_source_prior_and_rates.2.2]
  norm_num


def higherPriorWeights : Fin 4 → ℝ≥0 := ![19/200, 1/200, 9/200, 171/200]
def higherPriorPMF : PMF (Fin 4) := PMF.ofFintype
  (fun i => (higherPriorWeights i : ℝ≥0∞))
  (by norm_cast; norm_num [higherPriorWeights, Fin.sum_univ_succ])
def higherPriorLaw : Measure (Fin 4) := higherPriorPMF.toMeasure
instance higherPriorProbability : IsProbabilityMeasure higherPriorLaw := by
  unfold higherPriorLaw
  infer_instance

theorem actual_same_monitor_rates_with_changed_prior_give_a_different_posterior :
    higherPriorLaw.real faulty = 1/10 ∧
    (higherPriorLaw[|faulty]).real alarm = (alarmLaw[|faulty]).real alarm ∧
    (higherPriorLaw[|faultyᶜ]).real alarm = (alarmLaw[|faultyᶜ]).real alarm ∧
    (higherPriorLaw[|alarm]).real faulty = 19/28 ∧
    (higherPriorLaw[|alarm]).real faulty ≠ (alarmLaw[|alarm]).real faulty := by
  have hr := actual_normalized_alarm_experiment_has_the_source_prior_and_rates
  have hp := actual_alarm_posterior_and_complement_are_true_conditionals
  rw [actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio higherPriorLaw alarm faulty
    (Set.toFinite faulty).measurableSet,
    actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio higherPriorLaw alarm faultyᶜ
    (Set.toFinite faultyᶜ).measurableSet,
    actual_conditional_probability_is_the_printed_ratio higherPriorLaw faulty alarm
    (Set.toFinite alarm).measurableSet,
    hr.2.1, hr.2.2, hp.1]
  norm_num [higherPriorLaw, higherPriorPMF, higherPriorWeights, faulty, alarm,
    measureReal_def, PMF.toMeasure_apply_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Set.indicator,
    ← ENNReal.coe_add, ENNReal.toReal_add]
  all_goals simp (disch := finiteness) only [ENNReal.toReal_add]
  all_goals norm_num

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedConditioningAlarmMaterial25

/-- Any three equally likely retained atoms become equiprobable after conditioning.
The retained-event mass is derived by true finite measure additivity. -/
theorem actual_three_equal_retained_outcomes_have_conditional_probability_one_third
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSingletonClass Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (s : Finset Ω) (hs : s.card = 3)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (hm : ∀ i ∈ s, μ.real {i} = q) (i : Ω) (hi : i ∈ s) :
    (μ[| (s : Set Ω)]).real {i} = 1/3 := by
  classical
  have hsum : μ.real (s : Set Ω) = 3*q := by
    rw [← sum_measureReal_singleton]
    calc
      (∑ j ∈ s, μ.real {j}) = ∑ _j ∈ s, q :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => hm j hj)
      _ = 3*q := by simp [hs]
  have hsubset : ({i} : Set Ω) ⊆ (s : Set Ω) := singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal (cond_apply s.measurableSet μ ({i} : Set Ω))
  rw [inter_eq_right.mpr hsubset] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ← measureReal_def] at h
  rw [h, hm i hi, hsum]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hq]
  <;> ring

end SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedThreeEqualConditionalOutcomes25

Conditioning is updating on information. Once we know that an event $B$ happened, only outcomes inside $B$ remain possible, and their probabilities are rescaled so that they again sum to one.

Definition — Conditional probability, total probability, Bayes' rule
For $\mathbb P(B)\gt0$: $\mathbb P(A\mid B)=\mathbb P(A\cap B)/\mathbb P(B)$, equivalently the product rule $\mathbb P(A\cap B)=\mathbb P(A\mid B)\,\mathbb P(B)$. For a partition $B_1,\dots,B_k$ of $\Omega$ (disjoint events covering everything), the law of total probability and Bayes' rule read
$$\mathbb P(A)=\sum_{j}\mathbb P(A\mid B_j)\,\mathbb P(B_j),\qquad \mathbb P(B_i\mid A)=\frac{\mathbb P(A\mid B_i)\,\mathbb P(B_i)}{\sum_j\mathbb P(A\mid B_j)\,\mathbb P(B_j)} .$$
With a joint density: $p(x\mid y)=p(x,y)/p(y)$ and $p(y)=\int p(y\mid x)\,p(x)\,dx$.

Worked example (an alarm and the base rate). A fault occurs in $1\%$ of runs; a monitor detects a fault with probability $0.95$ and raises a false alarm on a healthy run with probability $0.05$. Given an alarm,

$$\mathbb P(\text{fault}\mid\text{alarm})=\frac{0.95\cdot0.01}{0.95\cdot0.01+0.05\cdot0.99}=\frac{0.0095}{0.059}\approx0.161 .$$

About five out of six alarms are false: a small false-alarm rate is swamped by the many healthy runs. Definition — Hypothesis test, false alarm, missed detection
A test decides between a null hypothesis $H_0$ (e.g. "the system has not changed") and an alternative $H_1$, rejecting $H_0$ when a statistic $T$ exceeds a threshold $c$. A false alarm (type I error) rejects a true $H_0$; its probability $\mathbb P_{H_0}(T\gt c)\le\alpha$ is the significance level. A missed detection (type II error) keeps a false $H_0$, with probability $\beta$; $1-\beta$ is the power. Raising $c$ trades false alarms for missed detections. Rejecting $H_0$ does not assign a posterior probability to $H_1$ (Section 2).
